sources.notes: Public Daily does not scrape: bounded official Vietnamese Foreign Affairs originals are collected in authenticated private custody. Only owner-approved, source-pinned, QA-passing, nonverbatim English machine explanations are signed into shared Daily and published. No public original Vietnamese headline/body, full translation, photograph, media, PDF or substantial excerpt. Ministry official claims are attributed, not independent corroboration.

Shared Daily collects the published first 50 listing entries and rechecks at most 15 VPCP candidates. Issuer must be Văn phòng Chính phủ. Bibliographic subjects, document numbers, issue dates, signatories and official links only; no PDF downloads, source-body storage, translations or models. No complete archive or full-document relevance claim. Source-use policy: config/vietnam_vpcp_metadata_policy.json.
